read.en: ASML rose 5.0% on Nov 6 to $1,424.75, trading $1,409.21–1,447.45 after opening at $1,446.08. It remains below the falling 5-day ($1,471.2), 10-day ($1,548.7), 30-day ($1,671.1) and 100-day ($1,724.5) and the rising 200-day ($1,600.2) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, with the histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,571.22), and RSI is 35.

The gap higher reclaimed the $1,364.8 Apr 28 low, now support, but stalled at $1,441–1,447. Resistance is $1,441.3–1,447.5 (May 19 low, Nov 5–6 highs), then $1,471–1,493.5 (5-day, Nov 4 low, Jan 28 high) and $1,530.6 (Jul 29 low). Support is $1,409.2 (Nov 6 low), then $1,364.8 and $1,329–1,333.6. A close above $1,447.5 would target $1,471–1,494; below $1,409, $1,365.
